title: A C¹ graph chart of a C^r embedded submanifold is C^r (compatibility of the charts for different r)
statement: Let P, d, r ∈ ℕ with r ≥ 1 and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C^r d-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d M). Let D ⊆ ℝ^d and W₀ ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let G : ℝ^d → ℝ^P be a C¹ local representation of M: G is C¹ on D and injective on D, G(D) = W₀ ∩ M, D ∩ G^{-1}(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W₀, and DG(a) is injective for every a ∈ D. Let π : ℝ^P → ℝ^d be a continuous linear map and c ∈ ℝ^P with π(G(a) − c) = a for every a ∈ D. Then G is of class C^r on D.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d r : ℕ) (M W₀ : Set (Euclid P)) (D : Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P) (π : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid d) (c : Euclid P), 1 ≤ r → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d M → IsOpen D → IsOpen W₀ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G D → InjOn G D → G '' D = W₀ ∩ M → (∀ K ⊆ W₀, IsCompact K → IsCompact (D ∩ G ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ a ∈ D, Injective (fderiv ℝ G a)) → (∀ a ∈ D, π (G a - c) = a) → ContDiffOn ℝ r G D
